name: A deterministic grid route
invalidMove: Remain in the same state and receive the nonterminal step reward.
terminal: Entering the goal ends the episode; the goal reward replaces the step reward.
truncation: A step limit resets the rollout but is not a terminal goal; bootstrap a nonterminal truncated transition.
tieBreak: Choose the first maximizing action in actions order.
usage: Environment specification only; no agent has been trained.

reference.method: Breadth-first search of the specified deterministic grid, not a learned result.
